main_text.p: minibus indulgeri ad ravim ufq; clamitant & vociferantur. Sed quid (malùm!) mentiendi hoc Cacoëthes sibi vult? Esse enim hoc insigne ac pellucidum men-dacium ex ingenuis ipsorum Pontificiorum confessionibus itá evicimus, ut si quam voluptá-tem illi falsò nos criminando ce-perint, eam Doctorum suorum confessionem veram audiendo amittant. Nec tamen satis erit hoc modo adversariorum no-strorum criminationes obtrivif-se, nisi etiam ex Patribus probe-mus, Protestantes bonorum o-perum necessitatem haud mino-rem, dignitatem verò longè il-lustriorem, & veræ pietatis pro-ventum

page.notes: The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page; the running head is in small capitals. "ufq;" is read as printed (usq;). "obtrivif-" is a doubtful reading of the line-end word; the scan is blurred there. Show-through from the facing page (faint words near the centre-right and lower left) is left out.
